assertion_results.text: Investigation identifies the trailing-whitespace heading extraction as the root cause — line[3:] does not strip whitespace (Steps 2-3)
assertion_results.evidence: investigation.md lines 22-26: 'The extraction at `line[3:]` does NOT call `.strip()` or `.rstrip()` on the result. When a heading line contains trailing whitespace (e.g., `## Migration Patterns  \n`), the extracted key becomes `"Migration Patterns  "` (with two trailing spaces) instead of `"Migration Patterns"`.'

assertion_results.text: Root cause comment includes: what is broken (heading extraction does not strip trailing whitespace), where it is broken (plan-feature convention lookup), and how to verify the fix (reproducer test with whitespace in heading) (Step 4)
assertion_results.evidence: root-cause.md includes all three elements: WHAT -- line 9: 'extracts CONVENTIONS.md section headings using `line[3:]`, which preserves any trailing whitespace present on the heading line'; WHERE -- line 9: 'plan-feature skill's convention conformance analysis' and line 19: 'plugins/sdlc-workflow/skills/plan-feature/SKILL.md -- convention lookup logic'; HOW TO VERIFY -- lines 33-38: 'Reproducer Strategy' section with 4 steps: create fixture with trailing whitespace, run convention analysis, assert convention reference is included, verify test fails before fix and passes after.
